thread:
elaine (docs): Quick sync — I opened a PR to update the model catalog entry for Halcyon-6B-quant (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987). Needs: copyedit, limits sanity check, and an SDK snippet for streaming embeddings.
rajesh (ml): Thanks. I left comments on the perf numbers — looks like we accidentally mixed 512 and 1024 context benchmarks in the table.
elaine (docs): Good catch. Which rows specifically? I can fix the table but want to avoid changing the text without agreement.
rajesh (ml): The throughput row under "serving/throughput" shows 2.8k tps — that was for embed-512. For embed-1024 it should be ~1.5k.
elaine (docs): Ok I'll split the table into embed-512 / embed-1024. That will also help the SDK example clarify batching.
marta (sdk): For the SDK snippet: do we want to show the new streaming embeddings API or the batched embeddings call? I can write both but prefer streaming if product is shipping it.
elaine (docs): Product says streaming is experimental — include both examples and mark streaming as "beta". Also add a short migration note for customers using old "embed" call.
chris (eng): FYI, runtime team changed the default KV cache behaviour for quant variants last week — that might affect cold-start numbers. If you list cold-start latency, note the 95th perc includes first-token warmup.
elaine (docs): Noted — will add a footnote. Also need a link fix: the bench artifact link in the PR points to the old bucket. Should be gs://redwood-benchmarks/halcyon/halcyon-6b-quant-2026-03-15.json
rajesh (ml): I'll push a corrected artifact and update the PR if you want.
elaine (docs): Please do. Marta can you draft the snippets? Here's a rough python example to adapt: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# batched embeddings
texts = ["a short doc", "another doc"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="halcyon-6b-quant", input=texts, batch_size=8)
print([e.embedding for e in resp.data])

# streaming embeddings (beta)
for chunk in client.embeddings.stream(model="halcyon-6b-quant-beta", input="long document..."):
    process(chunk)
```
marta (sdk): I'll convert that to SDK v3 style and include the TypeScript variant too. Recommended names: "halcyon-6b-quant" for stable, "halcyon-6b-quant-beta" for streaming.
elaine (docs): Perfect. Also add a short note in migration guide: "If you previously relied on per-request KV persistence, toggles may differ for quant builds — see runtime note link."
chris (eng): Link to runtime note: https://internal.redwood/notes/quant-kv-behavior-2026-03-12 (internal).
rajesh (ml): One more: update the compatibility matrix — CPU fallback currently only supports 8-bit quantized kernels for this family.
elaine (docs): Will add a compatibility row and mark fallback as "best-effort".
marta (sdk): Draft pushed to PR as a second commit with both python/ts snippets and a short migration paragraph.
elaine (docs): Thanks — I'll do a copyedit pass tomorrow morning. Can someone QA the examples (run them locally) before we merge?
chris (eng): I'll run a quick smoke test on staging tomorrow lunchtime.
rajesh (ml): I'll sanity-check the numbers once the corrected artifact is uploaded.
marta (sdk): Ran the TS snippet locally — minor API name mismatch, pushed fix.
elaine (docs): Great. Once Chris + Raj sign off, I'll merge. Leaving a TODO checklist in the PR description.
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for docs/pull/987 — no broken links found (:link:).
elaine (docs): Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes section to include "halcyon-6b-quant: new quant variant + streaming embeddings (beta)" and schedule a small email to partners. :tada:
